text: Figure 24 - launching the bulk importer with the -templates option Be sure to log in as the Teamcenter infodba user. The utility will ask you to select a directory location. Select a directory that contains the template models you wish to import. If your templates are distributed across multiple directory locations, you must run the bulk import utility multiple times, once for each directory.
